item.subject: science
item.stem:
Anjali has two identical cells and a torch at home in Pune. She places the two cells into the torch's battery holder in different ways to see which arrangement lights the bulb.
Which arrangement makes a working battery so that the bulb lights?

options.A: placing both cells with their positive terminals touching each other
options.B: placing the positive terminal of one cell touching the negative terminal of the other cell
options.C: placing only one cell in the holder, pointing the right way
options.D: placing both cells with their negative terminals touching each other
